message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libzmq && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/zmtp_engine.cpp","function":"handshake_v1_0","line":314,"var":"_decoder","code":"_decoder = new (std::nothrow) v1_decoder_t (_options.in_batch_size, _options.maxmsgsize);","note":"The ZMTP v1 handshake selects the vulnerable decoder and seeds it with the configured input batch size from attacker-controlled network traffic."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/stream_engine_base.cpp","function":"in_event","line":286,"var":"bufsize","code":"_decoder->get_buffer (&_inpos, &bufsize);","note":"The stream engine asks the decoder for a receive buffer before reading bytes from the socket."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/decoder.hpp","function":"get_buffer","line":84,"var":"_to_read","code":"if (_to_read >= _allocator.size ()) { *data_ = _read_pos; *size_ = _to_read; return; }","note":"The decoder can expose its internal message buffer directly when the pending payload is at least as large as the allocator buffer."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/decoder.hpp","function":"resize_buffer","line":150,"var":"new_size_","code":"void resize_buffer (std::size_t new_size_) ZMQ_FINAL { _allocator.resize (new_size_); }","note":"After each socket read, the engine forwards the exact number of bytes read into resize_buffer, even though the v1 static allocator is fixed-size and does not need resizing."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/decoder_allocators.hpp","function":"c_single_allocator","line":58,"var":"_buf_size","code":"void resize (std::size_t new_size_) { _buf_size = new_size_; }","note":"The static allocator mutates only its recorded size, not the backing allocation, so later buffer decisions are based on attacker-influenced read lengths rather than the real fixed capacity."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/decoder.hpp","function":"decode","line":84,"var":"_to_read","code":"if (_to_read >= _allocator.size ()) { *data_ = _read_pos; *size_ = _to_read; return; }","note":"Because the recorded allocator size can be reduced to the last read length, the zero-copy branch can be taken for a payload that still exceeds the actual static buffer capacity."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/v1_decoder.cpp","function":"flags_ready","line":139,"var":"_in_progress.data ()","code":"next_step (_in_progress.data (), _in_progress.size (), &v1_decoder_t::message_ready);","note":"The decoder then schedules the message body to be written into the message storage chosen from the stale allocator state."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/stream_engine_base.cpp","function":"in_event","line":289,"var":"read (_inpos, bufsize)","code":"const int rc = read (_inpos, bufsize);","note":"Network data is copied into the buffer pointer returned by the decoder, so an oversized zero-copy decision can direct the write past the fixed static allocation and crash the target."}
]
